bug_summary: ルートパターンが"/"のときTrimSuffixの連続適用で空文字列になってしまうエッジケースバグ
pr_description: Remove the special-cased `if routePattern != "/"` guard around the trailing-slash trims in `Context.RoutePattern`. `strings.TrimSuffix` is already a no-op when the suffix isn't present, so the guard was just extra branching around code that behaves correctly without it.
